AP control account is not restricted to sub-ledger postings.
Payment proposal does not exclude invoices with a cleared payment.
Disbursement can be released without a matched invoice reference.
No escalation path on payables beyond 90 days past due.
No ageing control on issued-but-uncleared disbursements.
No monthly tie-out control with a documented variance decomposition.
No completeness reconciliation on the nightly sub-ledger interface.
No uniqueness check on normalised vendor invoice number at entry.
Journal upload accepts a file that does not balance.
Bank-originated items are not auto-journalised from the statement feed.
Payments can be released at an amount other than the matched invoice.
Manual rate override is permitted at invoice entry.
No duplicate check on bank account or tax ID at vendor creation.
